import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def eq(req,pol,expected):
    r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert req==r0 and pol==p0; assert list(got)==['ok','value','reason']
base={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'admin'},'x>y':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}
eq({'from':'a','to':'b'},base,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})
eq({'from':'z','to':'b'},base,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})
eq({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'user','retry':True,'attempts':99},base,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
eq({'from':'x','to':'y','retry':True,'attempts':0},base,{'ok':True,'value':'y','reason':'ok'})
for attempts in (True,False,-1,2,2.0,None): eq({'from':'x','to':'y','retry':True,'attempts':attempts},base,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
assert all(set(x)=={'ok','value','reason'} for x in report)
print('all checks passed')

import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(req, policy, expected):
    req_before=copy.deepcopy(req); policy_before=copy.deepcopy(policy)
    result=evaluate(req,policy)
    assert result==expected,(result,expected)
    assert req==req_before and policy==policy_before
    assert list(result)==['ok','value','reason']

policy={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'admin'},'x>y':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}
check({'from':'a','to':'b'},policy,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})
check({'from':'q','to':'b'},policy,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})
check({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'user','retry':True,'attempts':99},policy,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
for attempts,ok in [(0,True),(1,True),(-1,False),(2,False),(True,False),(False,False),(1.0,False),(None,False)]:
    expected={'ok':ok,'value':'y' if ok else None,'reason':'ok' if ok else 'retry_limit'}
    check({'from':'x','to':'y','retry':True,'attempts':attempts},policy,expected)
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: current_policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,current_policy) for r in requests]
assert all(set(r)=={'ok','value','reason'} and len(r)==3 for r in report)
print('all checks passed')
